detection_focus: Malicious or rogue processes running in memory
Hidden background processes without user interface
Processes maintaining active C2 network connections
forensic_artifacts: Parent-child process tree from Sysmon or Event ID 4688

flags.security_use_case: Stop a confirmed malicious process identified during investigation.
flags.risk_if_misused: Killing critical system PID may crash system; verify identity first.
flags.safe_followup: Capture memory dump; document process path and hash; check persistence.

flags.purpose: Terminates all processes matching an image name.
flags.security_use_case: Kill multiple instances of known malicious executable.
flags.risk_if_misused: Legitimate apps with same name may be terminated.
flags.safe_followup: Verify executable path with tasklist /v; remove persistence entries.

flags.purpose: Terminates process and all child processes.
flags.security_use_case: Ensure malware process tree is completely stopped.
flags.risk_if_misused: May terminate legitimate child processes; analyze tree first.
flags.safe_followup: Review parent process origin; inspect scheduled tasks and services.

flags.security_use_case: Kill malware that resists graceful shutdown.
flags.risk_if_misused: Data loss or system instability if critical process is killed.
flags.safe_followup: Reboot system if instability occurs; verify no restart via persistence.

detection_queries.why_powerful: Quickly surfaces unusual or unknown running processes.
detection_queries.security_context: Initial triage to identify suspicious executables before termination.

detection_queries.why_powerful: Shows full process tree and command lines for accurate identification.
detection_queries.security_context: Understanding parent-child relationship before killing processes.

detection_queries.why_powerful: Links active network connections to process IDs for targeted kill.
detection_queries.security_context: Stopping active C2 communications by terminating owning process.

tool_relationship.paired_with: tasklist, netstat, procdump, schtasks, reg query
tool_relationship.attacker_usage: Attackers may kill security tools or AV processes to evade detection.
tool_relationship.defender_usage: Terminate malicious processes as part of incident containment.
